mission: Original, legally distributable, S2-validated natural Finnish listening for YKI-like EXAM without guessing digital 2027 playback controls; study multi-talker generalization after EXAM.

baseline.audio_player: native HTML audio controls; exact 2027 play/seek/replay unknown
baseline.legitimate_existing_human_files: Available elsewhere in the existing 85-file library (14 open originals, 12 excerpts, 15 LibriVox excerpts, 1 story); cannot promote to B1 live exam without individual rights/content/S2 checks.

source_evidence.finding: Historical Finnish middle-level samples include multiple choice, true-false and open responses; example genres include conversations, short situations, advertisements, report/news/story. Paper/studio instructions say twice played, which is NOT a live 2027 Inspera rule.
source_evidence.application: Teach three task families and spoken genres using independent original stimuli; preserve playback UNKNOWN.

source_evidence.finding: Digital intermediate Finnish pilot planned 2026-11-07 on test-centre computer; OPH does not specify current live listening playback, seek or timer.
source_evidence.application: Never import historical audio repeat/seek assumptions into strict exam.

source_evidence.finding: Listening ability must be contextualized by input type, length, speed, accent, task and comprehension purpose; question difficulty varies independently of text.
source_evidence.application: Tag source and task difficulty separately; avoid equating file length or TTS speed with YKI level.

source_evidence.finding: Bayesian network meta-analysis 32 studies 998 participants: talker variability and presentation format affect nonnative phonetic learning; high ranking six talkers versus no training, but no universally optimal number for Finnish YKI listening.
source_evidence.application: Experiment with diversity of human voices without assigning a fixed required number or % gain.

source_evidence.finding: Systematic review/meta analysis of multi-talker phonetic learning shows speech perception evidence is heterogeneous and differs by conditions; not automatic transfer to Finnish oral exam performance.
source_evidence.application: Evaluate unseen-voice comprehension, not number of voice files as a proxy for outcome.

source_evidence.finding: Controlled English academic listening test of 61 people: audio authenticity, explicit/implicit question focus and option-preview presentation interact. Not Finnish-specific and not the official YKI format.
source_evidence.application: In pilot compare scripted natural speech versus deliberately spontaneous speech at matched content/duration, separately for gist/detail/inference.

source_evidence.finding: 2024 EFL video experiment 64 learners: captions and speech rate impacted listening performance/cognitive effort; modality, language and learner group differ from Finnish YKI.
source_evidence.application: Show captions/transcripts for LEARN explanatory phase only; in EXAM do not expose any unsupported visual hints.

source_evidence.finding: 2026 meta-analysis of audiovisual input across 56 experiments, 1954 participants; reports pre-post learning effects, not direct Hospodar YKI evidence.
source_evidence.application: Optional LEARN audiovisual support, but audio-only new-form assessment and independent delayed outcomes.

draft_asset_contract.speakerIds: verified distinct speakers, no assumptions from gender labels
draft_asset_contract.rights: status, sourceUrl, rehostAllowed, attribution and speaker consent
draft_asset_contract.contentReview: two independent S2 reviewer IDs, actual approval

editorial_design_rules: Prefer naturally spoken, intelligible human Finnish with different speakers and registers; TTS is allowed as labelled LEARN practice only, not proof of authentic exam sound.
Multi-turn dialogue needs actual distinct voice identities and temporal turn-taking; do not invent YKI digital item order.
Semantic comprehension targets include gist, necessary detail and inference; separate explicit versus inferential item difficulty.
puhekieli is natural in contexts but not an arbitrary rule to maximize slang; formal announcements may use standard speech.
No fixed speech rate, SNR/loudness, noise layer, listen count, question preview or play/seek until first-party proof or controlled trial; noise addition can invalidate accessibility.
Source checks rights to distribute each media file, edits/transforms, voices/performer rights and any required credit; external examples remain links without permission.
Prohibit transcript, captions or correct answer display during closed EXAM; reveal aids in separate LEARN only after durable finish.
Never use same audio hash/identical source across LEARN and sealed held-out EXAM/transfer pools; audio reuse of different encodings should also be reviewed by content ID.
Playback errors and missing tracks block simulated results; don't silently credit correct responses without stimulus.
4GB storage is optional capacity, not content-quality target. Measure compressed size and only store independently rights-cleared useful material.

candidate_original_scenario_briefs.speech: two alternating human voices, realistic clarification
single clear announcer, schedule change and action
single natural speaker with narrative pragmatics

content_release_gates.criterion: Individual human audio and source rights, signed license/consent and proper attribution
Two independent Finnish S2 teachers sign off naturalness, semantic validity, language level and acceptable answer variants
Listening QA verifies intelligibility, clipping, balance, actual duration, stable file hashes, codec/device support and accessibility
Every released EXAM asset has no transcript/captions/answer exposure before sealed finish
Independent content and audio held-out pools with provenance and unseen speaker IDs
At least all three historical listening question families represented in reviewed original item bank; current mini only MCQ
Live 2027 playback/back/seek/timing from OPH corroborated and passed desktop browser E2E, otherwise practice only
Pilot compares real new-voice audio-only comprehension and delayed transfer, counterbalanced at equal exposure

trial_plan.design: Within-subject counterbalanced natural-human multi-talker vs current one-voice TTS in quality-matched original Finnish scenarios, with voices and content crossed; include strong equal-duration/feedback baseline.
trial_plan.primary: Day14 independent unseen-voice gist/detail comprehension; blind human review for open answers
trial_plan.secondary: Day30 new-topic comprehension; response latency only exploratory; listening confidence/distraction
trial_plan.avoid: do not compare easily recognized same item, do not call TTS worse solely because it is synthetic, do not infer human voice = native Finnish or higher CEFR, no claim of published effect replication without sample and power design.
